T57.mechanism: RDKit EmbedMolecule embeds each disconnected fragment independently and translates them all to the same point. Two waters of identical topology get the SAME conformer at the SAME coordinates; [OH2]x6.[Ru] puts six oxygens on one point and the twelve hydrogens in six coincident pairs.
T57.fix: molmetal/data/fragment_layout.py::separate_fragments keeps the largest fragment and the metal's fragment fixed, then translates each other fragment along a deterministic Fibonacci direction until its closest contact with the placed atoms is >= 2.0 A.

T58.mechanism: The metal was pushed along donor-minus-centroid until every HEAVY atom was >= 1.2 A away, with hydrogens excluded. A C-H or N-H sits exactly where 'straight out from the donor' lands, so the metal was placed on top of it. Pushing further out also walked the metal beyond the 2.6 A dative cutoff, leaving 21 clouds with a metal bonded to nothing.
T58.fix: _place_metal_at_donor now tests clearance against every atom (hydrogens included) and, when the straight-out position is blocked, searches tilted directions at the SAME 2.05 A bond length before falling back to pushing outward.

honest_limits: The separated solvent layout is not physical: a solvent molecule's position in a crystal is a fact about the crystal, and this loader has no crystal. The claim is only that the layout no longer teaches the model that atoms overlap.

The 2.0 A inter-fragment clearance and the 1.2 A metal clearance are chosen, not fitted. 1.2 A is above the geometry term's M-H clash threshold (0.7 * (1.36 + 0.31) = 1.17 A) so the truth stops being a clash at the same threshold the loss uses.
nonbonded_min is measured against the full RDKit bond set with explicit hydrogens; the trainer's own bond graph drops H bonds, so an O-H at 0.96 A is a bond there and is not counted as a clash here.

The dative target is capped at 3 per metal and lands at 1.49 per complex on this cohort (T59). Fragment separation and metal placement fix the GEOMETRY; they do not fix how many M-L edges the loader believes exist.

dative_target.note: Measured on the same 399 clouds AFTER the fix. The metal-donor target is capped at dative_top_k_cap = 3 in build_cloud_from_row, and the post-placement 2.6 A filter cuts it further. The result is a bond head trained to predict 1.49 M-L edges per complex, on a cohort of Ru/Ir/Os/Re/Rh complexes that are 4- and 6-coordinate.
dative_target.status: OPEN — recorded as T59, not changed here: the cap moves every archived bond-head target and needs a decision, not a silent edit.
